address: Chinatown Complex Market & Food Centre, #02-198/199, 335 Smith Street, 050335, Singapore
bio: It takes 30 minutes to cook but is more than worth the wait. The rice, cooked in a claypot over charcoal, exudes smokiness with a crispy scorched crust on the bottom. For toppings, choose between chicken, preserved pork and/or sausage....
